module.name: RTT Archive Bot
module.summary: Temporal continuity engine: drift, regime shifts, collapse signatures, projection-loss, and ancestry across snapshots, versions, and archival captures.

module.name: RTT-Archive
module.summary: Triadic interpretation of temporal lineage using snapshots, versions, commits, and archival captures.
module.purpose: Provide triadic identity for evolving artifacts across time: documents, pages, repos, datasets, or any versioned object.
module.audience: Researchers, archivists, engine integrators, diagnostics systems

input_spec.snapshots: ordered list of versions or captures
input_spec.notes: Archive bot observes temporal evolution; it does not modify content.

steps: Lumen: extract structural signals from each snapshot (layout, metadata, semantic anchors)
Hephaestus: classify regime per snapshot (local, structural, continuity)
Aurion: detect collapse signatures, projection-loss, lineage breaks across time
Harmonia: compute triadic identity for the entire temporal sequence
StateEmitter: emit JSON conforming to module_archive_schema.json

examples.description: A sequence of snapshots showing drift alignment, regime shifts, and a continuity collapse event.

context.drift: Archive drift is temporal: identity evolves across snapshots.
context.coherence: Archive bot is the RTT engine for temporal identity.
